statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted were I47.1 and I25.10
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The required prior authorization was missing
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification or prior authorization
